# Editing this package

- Use `src/` for edits. `dist/` is generated by `python3 build.py`.
- Read only relevant sections of view files. Do not print the full generated
  HTML or encoded image contents into tool output.
- Preserve the single-page shell, existing navigation, lesson behavior, and
  browser storage keys unless the user requests a behavior change.
- Images in `src/assets/` are the original decoded bytes. Do not recompress them
  merely to rebuild the HTML.
- Keep the `$labText` JSON reviver in `src/shell.js` in sync with `build.py`.
- Publish only when the user requests publication. Packaging source is not a
  request to deploy it.
